cond_0001.intro: This Consulting Actuary will serve as a senior-level individual contributor on our Pharmacy Analytics team. This individual will be expected to leverage foundational actuarial and analytical competencies to help the organization perform all actuarial functions required in support of our Pharmacy strategy. As a senior-level individual contributor, this position will be expected to work collaboratively with company stakeholders and other actuarial areas to achieve these objectives and will often be responsible for managing the work of junior members of the team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership. Supports pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis. Monitors and forecasts pharmacy profitability and communicates this information to leadership. Provides actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives. Communicates and collaborates effectively with key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics. Directs the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc. Monitors industry news and ensures the company is competitively well-positioned in a dynamic marketplace. Proactively reviews advanced data analytic methods and identifies opportunities to improve team processes. Works effectively with external vendors, including PBM partner contacts. Represents actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas. Performs other duties and special projects as required. Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required).
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries.
7 Years of relevant actuarial experience, related experience may be considered.
In lieu of an FSA, will consider candidates who are an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) and have at least 9 years of relevant actuarial experience.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Pharmacy Analytics.
Strong communication skills.

As a senior-level individual contributor, this position will be expected to work collaboratively with company stakeholders and other actuarial areas to achieve these objectives and will often be responsible for managing the work of junior members of the team. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the actuarial and analytical logic behind pharmacy data.
cond_0121.responsibilities: Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership. Supports pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis. Monitors and forecasts pharmacy profitability and communicates this information to leadership. Provides actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives. Communicates and collaborates effectively with key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics. Directs the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc. Monitors industry news and ensures the company is competitively well-positioned in a dynamic marketplace. Proactively reviews advanced data analytic methods and identifies opportunities to improve team processes. Works effectively with external vendors, including PBM partner contacts. Represents actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas. Performs other duties and special projects as required. Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0121.requirements:
Experience with Pharmacy Analytics is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required).
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries.
7 Years of relevant actuarial experience, related experience may be considered.
In lieu of an FSA, will consider candidates who are an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) and have at least 9 years of relevant actuarial experience.
Strong communication skills are preferred.
cond_0121.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0301.intro: This Consulting Actuary will serve as a senior-level individual contributor on our Pharmacy Analytics team. This individual will be expected to leverage foundational actuarial and analytical competencies to help the organization perform all actuarial functions required in support of our Pharmacy strategy. As a senior-level individual contributor, this position will be expected to work collaboratively with company stakeholders and other actuarial areas to achieve these objectives and will often be responsible for managing the work of junior members of the team. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the actuarial and analytical logic behind pharmacy data.
cond_0301.responsibilities: Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership. Supports pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis. Monitors and forecasts pharmacy profitability and communicates this information to leadership. Provides actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives. Communicates and collaborates effectively with key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics. Directs the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc. Monitors industry news and ensures the company is competitively well-positioned in a dynamic marketplace. Proactively reviews advanced data analytic methods and identifies opportunities to improve team processes. Works effectively with external vendors, including PBM partner contacts. Represents actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas. Performs other duties and special projects as required. Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0301.requirements:
Experience with Pharmacy Analytics is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required).
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries.
7 Years of relevant actuarial experience, related experience may be considered.
In lieu of an FSA, will consider candidates who are an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) and have at least 9 years of relevant actuarial experience.
Strong communication skills are preferred.
cond_0301.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

As a senior-level individual contributor, this position will be expected to work collaboratively with company stakeholders and other actuarial areas to achieve these objectives and will often be responsible for managing the work of junior members of the team.
cond_0343.responsibilities: Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership. Supports pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis. Monitors and forecasts pharmacy profitability and communicates this information to leadership. Provides actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives. Communicates and collaborates effectively with key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics. Directs the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc. Monitors industry news and ensures the company is competitively well-positioned in a dynamic marketplace. Proactively reviews advanced data analytic methods and identifies opportunities to improve team processes. Works effectively with external vendors, including PBM partner contacts. Represents actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas. Performs other duties and special projects as required. Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0343.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required).
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries.
7 Years of relevant actuarial experience, related experience may be considered.
In lieu of an FSA, will consider candidates who are an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) and have at least 9 years of relevant actuarial experience.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Pharmacy Analytics.
Strong communication skills.
cond_0343.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

cond_0371.intro: This Consulting Actuary will serve as a senior-level individual contributor on our Pharmacy Analytics team. This individual will be expected to leverage foundational actuarial and analytical competencies to help the organization perform all actuarial functions required in support of our Pharmacy strategy. As a senior-level individual contribution, this position will be expected to work collaboratively with company stakeholders and other actuarial areas to achieve these objectives and will often be responsible for managing the work of junior members of the team.
cond_0371.responsibilities: Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership. Supports pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis. Monitors and forecasts pharmacy profitability and communicates this information to leadership. Provides actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives. Communicates and collaborates effectively with key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics. Directs the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc. Monitors industry news and ensures the company is competitively well-positioned in a dynamic marketplace. Proactively reviews advanced data analytic methods and identifies opportunities to improve team processes. Works effectively with external vendors, including PBM partner contacts. Represents actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas. Performs other duties and special projects as required. Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0371.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise in Pharmacy Analytics is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries.
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated actuarial expertise; substantial related experience may be considered.
In lieu of an FSA, will consider candidates who hold an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) designation with at least 9 years of proven actuarial experience.
Exceptional communication skills are preferred.

This individual will be expected to leverage foundational actuarial and analytical competencies to help the organization perform all actuarial functions required in support of our Pharmacy strategy. As a senior-level individual contributor, this position will be expected to work collaboratively with company stakeholders and other actuarial areas to achieve these objectives and will often be responsible for managing the work of junior members of the team. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with pharmacy analytics and actuarial work.
cond_0500.responsibilities:
Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership.
Supports pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis.
Monitors and forecasts pharmacy profitability and communicates this information to leadership.
Provides actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives.
Communicates and collaborates effectively with key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics.
Directs the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc.
Monitors industry news and ensures the company is competitively well-positioned in a dynamic marketplace.
Proactively reviews advanced data analytic methods and identifies opportunities to improve team processes.
Works effectively with external vendors, including PBM partner contacts.
Represents actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas.
Performs other duties and special projects as required.
Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0500.requirements:
Experience with Pharmacy Analytics is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required).
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries.
7 Years of relevant actuarial experience, related experience may be considered.
In lieu of an FSA, will consider candidates who are an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) and have at least 9 years of relevant actuarial experience.
Strong communication skills are preferred.

cond_0622.intro: This Consulting Actuary will serve as a senior-level individual contributor on our Pharmacy Analytics team. This individual will be expected to leverage foundational actuarial and analytical competencies to help the organization perform all actuarial functions required in support of our Pharmacy strategy. As a senior-level individual contribution, this position will be expected to work collaboratively with company stakeholders and other actuarial areas to achieve these objectives and will often be responsible for managing the work of junior members of the team.
cond_0622.responsibilities: Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership. Supports pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis. Monitors and forecasts pharmacy profitability and communicates this information to leadership. Provides actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives. Communicates and collaborates effectively with key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics. Directs the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc. Monitors industry news and ensures the company is competitively well-positioned in a dynamic marketplace. Proactively reviews advanced data analytic methods and identifies opportunities to improve team processes. Works effectively with external vendors, including PBM partner contacts. Represents actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas. Performs other duties and special projects as required. Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0622.requirements:
Experience with Pharmacy Analytics is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required).
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries.
7 Years of relevant actuarial experience, related experience may be considered.
In lieu of an FSA, will consider candidates who are an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) and have at least 9 years of relevant actuarial experience.
Strong communication skills are preferred.
cond_0622.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Communicate effectively with all levels and divisions within the organization, including Divisional Leadership.
Support pharmacy trend and hot spot analysis.
Monitor and forecast pharmacy profitability and share this information with leadership.
Coordinate actuarial support for corporate pharmacy initiatives.
Work alongside key pharmacy stakeholders, including senior leadership, on relevant pharmacy topics.
Collaborate on the development of pricing research projects, including experience and trend analyses, book of business studies, vendor analyses, etc.
Monitor industry news and help ensure [Company name masked] is competitively well-positioned in the marketplace.
Review advanced data analytic methods and identify opportunities to improve team processes.
Work alongside external vendors, including PBM partner contacts.
Represent the actuarial team during meetings with management from other functional areas.
Perform other duties and special projects as required.
Meet continuing education standards required for job function, thought leadership, and maintenance of actuarial credentials.
cond_0639.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required).
Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA), or an Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) with at least 9 years of relevant actuarial experience.
7 Years of relevant actuarial experience; related experience may be considered.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Pharmacy Analytics.
Strong communication skills.
